parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$AT$, $BT=r\tan\theta$ or $OT=\frac r{\cos\theta}$ | B1 | May be seen on the diagram.
Use sector area $\frac12r^2(2\theta)$ and a correct triangle-area expression, such as $\frac12r(r\tan\theta)$. | M1 | Both formulae are required, with $2\theta$ used where needed.
$\frac12r^2(2\theta)=2\left[\frac12r(r\tan\theta)\right]-\frac12r^2(2\theta)\Rightarrow2\theta=\tan\theta$ | A1 | AG; fully correct working.
Total: 3
